x: Shows open sockets: listening ports, established connections and the process that owns each one. Modern replacement for netstat. sudo ss -tulpn
Legacy tool from net-tools that lists connections, listening ports, routing tables and interface statistics. sudo netstat -tulpn
Shows the IP addresses and state of every network interface (use ip link or ip addr without -br to see MAC addresses). ip -br addr show
Displays the kernel routing table, including the default gateway. ip route show
Captures and prints network packets on an interface, with powerful filters. Can also save captures to a pcap file for Wireshark. sudo tcpdump -i eth0 -nn -c 50 port 53
Queries the systemd journal, the central log store on most modern Linux systems. journalctl -u ssh.service --since today
Controls and inspects systemd services, timers and other units. systemctl list-units --type=service --state=running
Lists running processes with their PID, parent, owner and full command line. ps -ef --forest
Lists open files, and because sockets are files, shows which process holds which network connection. sudo lsof -i -P -n
Searches the filesystem by name, type, owner, size, permissions or modification time. sudo find /etc /usr/local/bin -type f -mtime -2 -ls
Changes file permission bits (read, write, execute) for owner, group and others. chmod 600 ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
Changes the owner and group of files and directories. sudo chown root:root /etc/cron.d/backup
Lists all files including hidden dot files, with permissions, owner, size and date. ls -la /tmp
Shows detailed metadata for a file: size, permissions, owner, inode and access, modify and change times. stat /etc/passwd
Computes or verifies SHA256 hashes of files. sha256sum ubuntu.iso
Searches text or files for lines that match a pattern or regular expression. grep -i "failed password" /var/log/auth.log
Shows the history of user logins, logouts and reboots from the wtmp file. last -F -n 20
Shows who is logged in right now, with terminal and login time. who -a
Prints the user ID, group ID and all groups of a user. id alice
Lists the commands a user is allowed to run with sudo, as defined in sudoers. sudo -l -U alice
Lists the scheduled cron jobs of the current user, or of another user when run as root. sudo crontab -l -u alice
Lists the rules in the netfilter firewall tables with packet and byte counters. sudo iptables -L -n -v --line-numbers
Shows the path packets take to a destination, hop by hop, with round trip times. traceroute -n example.com
PowerShell cmdlet that reads Windows event logs and ETW logs with fast filtering. Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security'; Id=4625} -MaxEvents 20
Lists TCP connections and listening ports with the owning process ID. Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess
Lists running processes with CPU, memory, ID and optional file path. Get-Process | Sort-Object CPU -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 Name,Id,CPU,Path
Lists Windows services and their status. Get-Service | Where-Object Status -eq 'Running'
Lists local user accounts on the machine. Get-LocalUser | Select-Object Name,Enabled,LastLogon
Lists the members of a local group. Get-LocalGroupMember -Group "Administrators"
Computes the hash of a file, SHA256 by default. Get-FileHash .\setup.exe -Algorithm SHA256
Lists scheduled tasks with their path and state. Get-ScheduledTask | Where-Object State -ne 'Disabled' | Select-Object TaskPath,TaskName,State
Shows the status of Microsoft Defender Antivirus on the machine. Get-MpComputerStatus | Select-Object AMServiceEnabled,RealTimeProtectionEnabled,AntivirusSignatureLastUpdated
Command line tool to query, export and manage Windows event logs. wevtutil qe Security /c:5 /rd:true /f:text
Shows all connections and listening ports with numeric addresses and the owning process ID. netstat -ano
Shows full IP configuration for every adapter: IP, MAC, gateway, DNS servers and DHCP details. ipconfig /all
Shows the security privileges held by the current user token. whoami /priv
Lists running processes in cmd, with optional service and module details. tasklist /svc
Lists scheduled tasks from cmd, with full details in verbose mode. schtasks /query /fo LIST /v
Lists local user accounts, or shows details for one account. net user alice
Displays or changes NTFS access control lists on files and folders. icacls C:\Shares\Finance
Tests connectivity to a host, including whether a specific TCP port is reachable. Test-NetConnection -ComputerName server01 -Port 443
PowerShell DNS lookup tool that queries any record type. Resolve-DnsName example.com -Type MX
Windows traceroute: shows each router hop to a destination with timings. tracert -d example.com
Shows which Windows audit policy categories are logged (success, failure or none). auditpol /get /category:*
Open source network scanner that discovers hosts, open ports and service versions. nmap -sn 192.168.1.0/24
DNS lookup tool from ISC BIND that shows full query and answer details. dig example.com MX +short
Simple DNS lookup tool available on Windows, Linux and macOS. nslookup -type=mx example.com
Sends ICMP echo requests to test whether a host is reachable and measure latency. ping -c 4 192.168.1.1   (Windows: ping -n 4 192.168.1.1)
Fetches only the HTTP response headers of a URL. curl -I https://example.com
Shows the ARP cache: IP to MAC address mappings the host has learned on the local network. arp -a
Displays the configuration currently active in RAM on the router or switch. show running-config | section line vty
One line summary of every interface: IP address, status and protocol state. show ip interface brief
Detailed status and counters for interfaces: errors, drops, speed, duplex and traffic rates. show interfaces GigabitEthernet0/1
Lists VLANs on a switch with their names, status and access ports. show vlan brief
Shows the MAC addresses the switch has learned and the port and VLAN for each. show mac address-table dynamic interface GigabitEthernet1/0/5
Lists directly connected Cisco devices discovered with Cisco Discovery Protocol. show cdp neighbors detail
Displays configured access control lists with per rule match counters. show access-lists
Shows syslog settings and the contents of the local logging buffer. show logging | include SEC_LOGIN
Displays the IPv4 routing table with how each route was learned. show ip route
Shows the IOS version, uptime, hardware model, serial number and last reload reason. show version
